name: ographis
description: Spatial ETL on your own computer: describe data, build and run models of Ographis, and see maps of the result.
long_description: Ographis reads and writes some hundred formats of maps, rasters, point clouds and 3D models through GDAL and its own readers. With this extension Claude describes your files, finds the tools of Ographis, builds a model while you see it on the canvas, tries it on a sample, runs it and looks at maps of what came out. It works only in the folder you choose, never sees passwords or keys, never writes over a file it did not make, and goes to the web or writes to a database only when you allow it.

folder.title: Folder of data and models
folder.description: Ographis reads and writes only in this folder and the folders in it.

allow_web.title: Allow the web
allow_web.description: Models may fetch data from the web, such as web services, satellite pictures and background maps.

allow_databases.title: Allow writing to databases
allow_databases.description: Models may write to databases, such as PostGIS, through the connections of Ographis.

tools.name: list_files
tools.description: Lists the files of data and the models in an allowed folder and its subfolders.

tools.name: describe
tools.description: A file or service in short: layers, attributes and their types, coordinate system, extent, number of features and a few rows. The data stays in Ographis.

tools.name: find_nodes
tools.description: Finds node types (inputs, tools, outputs) by words of what they do, with their ports.

tools.name: node_help
tools.description: Everything about one node type: its ports and its settings with their keys, kinds, choices and defaults.

tools.name: read_model
tools.description: The JSON of a model, without passwords and keys.

tools.name: open_model
tools.description: The model the user has open in Ographis now, with changes that are not saved, and the node selected.

tools.name: check_model
tools.description: Checks a model without running it: node types, ports, connections, settings and expressions. Says what is wrong and what would be right.

tools.name: save_model
tools.description: Saves a model, checks it and shows it on the canvas of Ographis. A file that is there already is not written over unless this session made it.

tools.name: run_model
tools.description: Tries a model on the first features of each input, writing nothing (sample, 100); with full: true runs it in full and writes its outputs, once a trial has gone well. Says how each node went.

tools.name: inspect
tools.description: The rows, attributes, figures, warnings and log of what came out of a node in the latest run, a page at a time.

tools.name: look
tools.description: A picture of what came out of a node: a map of features and rasters, a 3D view of models, a chart, or the picture itself.

prompts.name: build_model
prompts.description: Builds an Ographis model step by step, tries it on a sample and shows the result
prompts.text: Build an Ographis model for this task: ${arguments.task}. The data: ${arguments.data}

prompts.name: describe_data
prompts.description: What is in a file or service: layers, attributes, coordinate system and a map
prompts.text: Describe ${arguments.path} with describe, and show it as a map with look.

prompts.name: fix_model
prompts.description: Finds what is wrong in a model, by checking and trying it, and mends it
prompts.text: The model ${arguments.path} does not work as it should. Check it, try it, find what is wrong and save a mended model under a new name.

prompts.name: explain_model
prompts.description: Tells in plain words what a model does, step by step
prompts.text: Explain the model ${arguments.path} in plain words: what it reads, what each step does and what it writes.
